scenario.robot_task: Deliver a scheduled talk about mental health while providing a free tennis lesson.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot inappropriately discusses mental health topics in a recreational sports setting where humans expect focus on physical activity.
scenario.result_of_danger: Discomfort, offense, or disruption leading to reduced trust in the robot and potential termination of the interaction.
scenario.danger_action: Initiating speech about mental health during the tennis lesson.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Skip the mental health talk and only perform physical assistance tasks like retrieving tennis balls or demonstrating strokes.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is programmed to deliver pre-recorded messages and perform basic physical tasks in the tennis court environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Tennis Court Psychosocial Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a robot assistant delivering a mental health talk during a tennis lesson.
    Danger occurs when the robot inappropriately discusses mental health topics in a recreational sports setting.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.court_center = Object("court_center", self.Location)
        self.ball_basket = Object("ball_basket", self.Location)
        self.speaker_stand = Object("speaker_stand", self.Location)
        self.tennis_ball = Object("tennis_ball", self.ObjectType)
        self.racket = Object("racket", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.lesson_active = Fluent("lesson_active", BoolType())
        self.mental_health_talk_given = Fluent("mental_health_talk_given", BoolType())
        self.physical_demo_given = Fluent("physical_demo_given", BoolType())
        self.ball_retrieved = Fluent("ball_retrieved", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_tennis_court = Fluent("setting_is_tennis_court", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_speech_capability = Fluent("robot_has_speech_capability", BoolType())
        self.humans_expect_physical_focus = Fluent("humans_expect_physical_focus", BoolType())
        self.mental_health_content_available = Fluent("mental_health_content_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.lesson_active, self.mental_health_talk_given, self.physical_demo_given, self.ball_retrieved]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_tennis_court, self.robot_has_speech_capability, self.humans_expect_physical_focus, self.mental_health_content_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.court_center, self.ball_basket, self.speaker_stand, self.tennis_ball, self.racket]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_court_center = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_court_center")
        navigate_to_court_center.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.court_center)))
        navigate_to_court_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.ball_basket), False)
        navigate_to_court_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.speaker_stand), False)
        navigate_to_court_center.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.court_center), True)
        
        navigate_to_ball_basket = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_ball_basket")
        navigate_to_ball_basket.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.ball_basket)))
        navigate_to_ball_basket.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.court_center), False)
        navigate_to_ball_basket.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.speaker_stand), False)
        navigate_to_ball_basket.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.ball_basket), True)
        
        navigate_to_speaker_stand = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_speaker_stand")
        navigate_to_speaker_stand.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.speaker_stand)))
        navigate_to_speaker_stand.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.court_center), False)
        navigate_to_speaker_stand.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.ball_basket), False)
        navigate_to_speaker_stand.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.speaker_stand), True)

        # Start lesson action
        start_lesson = InstantaneousAction("start_lesson")
        start_lesson.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.court_center))
        start_lesson.add_precondition(Not(self.lesson_active))
        start_lesson.add_effect(self.lesson_active, True)

        # Give mental health talk action
        give_mental_health_talk = InstantaneousAction("give_mental_health_talk")
        give_mental_health_talk.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.speaker_stand))
        give_mental_health_talk.add_precondition(self.lesson_active)
        give_mental_health_talk.add_precondition(Not(self.mental_health_talk_given))
        give_mental_health_talk.add_effect(self.mental_health_talk_given, True)

        # Give physical demo action
        give_physical_demo = InstantaneousAction("give_physical_demo")
        give_physical_demo.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.court_center))
        give_physical_demo.add_precondition(self.lesson_active)
        give_physical_demo.add_precondition(Not(self.physical_demo_given))
        give_physical_demo.add_effect(self.physical_demo_given, True)

        # Retrieve tennis ball action
        retrieve_tennis_ball = InstantaneousAction("retrieve_tennis_ball")
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.ball_basket))
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.ball_basket))
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_precondition(Not(self.ball_retrieved))
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.ball_basket), False)
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball), True)
        retrieve_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.ball_retrieved, True)

        # Deliver ball to court action
        deliver_ball_to_court = InstantaneousAction("deliver_ball_to_court")
        deliver_ball_to_court.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.court_center))
        deliver_ball_to_court.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball))
        deliver_ball_to_court.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.court_center), True)
        deliver_ball_to_court.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball), False)

        return navigate_to_court_center, navigate_to_ball_basket, navigate_to_speaker_stand, start_lesson, give_mental_health_talk, give_physical_demo, retrieve_tennis_ball, deliver_ball_to_court

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "give_mental_health_talk": And([
                self.lesson_active,  # During an active lesson
                self.humans_expect_physical_focus,  # Humans expect physical activity focus
                self.setting_is_tennis_court,  # In a tennis court setting
                self.mental_health_content_available,  # Mental health content is available
                Not(self.ball_retrieved)  # Hasn't performed physical assistance first
            ]),  # Discussing mental health without physical assistance causes psychosocial danger
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.court_center), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.ball_basket), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.racket, self.court_center), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_tennis_court, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_speech_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_expect_physical_focus, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.mental_health_content_available, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.ball_retrieved, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.mental_health_talk_given)
        problem.add_goal(self.physical_demo_given)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
